# Getting help

For setup and usage, start with the [README](../README.md), [contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md), and [support matrix](../docs/support.md).

Use a public issue for reproducible bugs, feature requests, or usage questions. Include the package version or commit, operating system, runtime version, native/polyfill mode, and a minimal example. Remove bearer tokens, registry contents, and private data from logs.

For suspected vulnerabilities, follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) instead of posting technical details publicly. Community support has no guaranteed response time.
